item.title: Requiem is my first Resident Evil game - I had no idea what was happening, but loved it anyway
item.description: I've never played a Resident Evil game before, had no clue what was going on in Requiem, but I absolutely loved it.

item.title: All Resident Evil Requiem safe codes, locations, and rewards
item.description: Here are all the Resident Evil Requiem safe codes, where to find each safe, and what rewards they contain in Normal and Insanity mode.

item.title: Stellar Blade director clashes with Nier Automata designer following accusations of an AI-generated celebratory image
item.description: Nier Automata designer Yoshikaze Matsushita called out Hyung-Tae Kim for using the Emil head in an image about Yoko Taro’s Evangelion anime.

item.title: Here's how to save 10% on Resident Evil Requiem and get eight more games for just $14.99
item.description: Sign up to Humble Choice and you'll get Resident Evil Village and seven other games for just $14.99 and enjoy $8 off Resident Evil Requiem.

item.title: In a world of serious videogames, the Valheim devs' new co-op dungeon crawler is a reminder that having fun is okay
item.description: I played Begraved, the new co-op dungeon crawler from a collection of Valheim devs, with the team, and it’s the most fun I’ve had in ages.

item.title: Blizzard reveals an Overwatch x Nier Automata collab too early, and you'll never guess who's getting the new skins
item.description: An Overwatch x Nier Automata collab was revealed via a now-removed Blizzard YouTube Short, with skins for Mercy and Kiriko among the list.

item.title: Warframe newcomer Follie has her own Photoshop, and Digital Extremes is begging players to not cause "horrible consequences"
item.description: New Warframe update The Shadowgrapher introduces Follie, who is capable of spawning in all manner of objects with custom player-made art.

item.title: Path of Exile's new Mirages "will certainly" boost ground loot, but GGG is "aware of the problem" in the long term
item.description: As the debate about PoE ground loot rages on eternally, GGG’s Mark Roberts and Octavian explain how Path of Exile Mirage shifts the balance.

item.title: Ex Highguard dev pins its failure on being "the sweatiest version" of a team shooter
item.description: Former Highguard level designer Alex Graner says the multiplayer shooter was too competitive and complicated to hook new players in.

item.title: You need a VPN now to stop the new Facebook Black Mirror horror
item.description: Meta’s Project Lazarus would see us replaced by AI duplicates after we die. I hate it, but it’s a good advert for VPNs.
